Detail: Currently in use. Enabled by default with no additional configuration required. Cost data is only aggregated at the Master Payer account level.
Challenge(s): Access is limited to the Master Payer account, preventing teams from self-serving cost visibility. Granting per-team access would require individual delegation across each account scope, creating significant access management overhead.
Recommendations: Delegate cost visibility through Apptio to aggregate spend data and provide self-service reporting. This removes the need to grant broad access to the Master Payer account and reduces access management complexity.

Detail: Partially adopted. Used in limited pockets for alerting. Intent exists to expand use for enforcing spending thresholds, particularly for Sandbox environments.
Challenge(s): Spending thresholds have not been formally defined. Requires alignment between IT leadership and Finance to establish appropriate guardrails before broader rollout is feasible.
Recommendations: Facilitate a working session between BTLs and Finance to define spending thresholds by team or environment. Prioritize Sandbox environment limits to enable team autonomy with financial guardrails. Provide targeted FinOps training for IT leadership.

Detail: Enabled but not operationalized. Anomaly findings are generated but no monitoring workflow or remediation process exists, resulting in alerts that are never reviewed or acted upon.
Challenge(s): No defined owner or escalation process for anomaly findings. Without active monitoring, cost anomalies go unaddressed, increasing financial risk.
Recommendations: Assign a central monitoring owner responsible for reviewing anomaly findings on a defined cadence. Define an escalation and remediation workflow to ensure findings are routed to the appropriate resource owners and resolved in a timely manner.

Detail: Enabled. NTT leverages this data to identify rightsizing and cost optimization opportunities across compute resources.
Challenge(s): Recommendations are generated but it is unclear what percentage are being reviewed and acted upon. Executives require visibility into recommendation adoption rates to assess ROI.
Recommendations: Define a process to track and report on the adoption rate of NTT's optimization recommendations. Establish a regular review cadence to ensure recommendations are prioritized and implemented.

Detail: Enabled. NTT leverages this data alongside Compute Optimizer to surface broader cost optimization opportunities across AWS services.
Challenge(s): Recommendations are generated but it is unclear what percentage are being reviewed and acted upon. Executives require visibility into recommendation adoption rates to assess ROI.
Recommendations: Align with NTT to produce a consolidated report of open recommendations, their estimated savings, and implementation status. Review quarterly with IT leadership.

Detail: Currently in use. CUR exports are ingested by Apptio for cost reporting and analysis.
Challenge(s): Finance teams consuming the data in Apptio lack sufficient context to interpret CUR data effectively, limiting the accuracy and value of cost reporting and decision-making.
Recommendations: Provide targeted training for Finance teams on CUR data structure and how it maps to Apptio reporting. Improved data literacy will enhance the quality of cost insights delivered to leadership.
